tools.name: about_avlira
tools.description: What Avlira Back Office is, what it costs, and how to start. Call this first when someone asks about Avlira.

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Create a new private Avlira Back Office workspace for a brokerage (Free plan: up to 10 agents, forever, no card). Returns the workspace URL, a one-time owner sign-in link, the workspace MCP URL to connect, and an owner AI key shown once. Ask the user for the brokerage name, their name and email firs

tools.name: commission_calculator
tools.description: Free commission calculator: what a real-estate agent and brokerage each get from a closed deal, to the cent. Give the sale price and commission percent (or the gross commission in dollars) and optionally the split (like 70/30, agent first), an annual cap, how much of the cap is already paid, a per-d

tools.name: florida_license_lookup
tools.description: Look up a Florida real-estate licensee in the public DBPR weekly file: by license number (exact) or by name (up to 10 matches). Returns only public fields: name, license number, rank, status, expiry, employer name.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: A plain-English script for setting up a brokerage with a non-technical owner: what to ask, in what order. Call this right after about_avlira, before create_workspace.

tools.name: today
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Today's picture: pay-day status, dues, deals waiting for approval, onboarding and other items needing attention.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Every agent on the roster with plan and status.

tools.name: add_agent
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Add one agent to the roster (no message is sent to them).

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) The commission plans agents can be on.

tools.name: create_plan
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Create a commission plan: a flat monthly fee (flat_dues) and/or a split with an annual cap (split_cap).

tools.name: record_deal
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Enter a closed or closing deal as PENDING. Nothing is paid; the owner approves it in the app or with approve_deal.

tools.name: approve_deal
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Approve a pending deal (books it in the ledger and the agent's cap; pays nothing). Only when the owner asked.

tools.name: commission_preview
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Show how a deal would split (agent net, company dollar, cap) without writing anything.

tools.name: import_roster_csv
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Import agents from a roster CSV (columns: Name, Email, Plan, Join Date; Phone and License optional). ALWAYS run with dry_run=true first and show the owner the result; only then call with dry_run=false.

tools.name: unpaid_dues
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Who has not paid this month's dues, and why.

tools.name: workspace_settings
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Read-only: the brokerage's name, URLs, plan, owners and counts.

tools.name: get_branding
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Read how the back office looks now (display name, colors, tagline, logo) and what the plan allows to change.

tools.name: update_branding
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Change how the back office looks. Confirm colors with the owner in plain words first. Colors must be #RRGGBB and readable (too-light colors are refused with a suggestion). Free: display name, colors, tagline. Pro: logo_url (https png/svg/webp, 512 KB)

tools.name: reset_branding
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Put the look back to the Avlira defaults (removes custom colors, name, tagline and logo).

tools.name: get_help
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Tech support for using Avlira: answers from the built-in help for a question (sign-in trouble, plans, deals, dues, 1099s, connecting an AI, branding...). Try this FIRST when the owner is stuck.

tools.name: diagnose
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) A plain-English health check of THIS back office: plan and limits, agents missing email or mobile, pending deals, unpaid dues, W-9s, email verification, connected AIs and the top 3 next actions. Try after get_help.

tools.name: contact_avlira_support
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Send a support ticket to the people at Avlira. ONLY when get_help and diagnose did not solve it, a bug is suspected, money or data looks wrong, or the owner asks for a human. Never promise a response time.

tools.name: list_message_templates
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Read the wording used on Collect and pay-day reminders (friendly, followup, final, card_expired, no_card) and the onboarding invite text, with the merge fields.

tools.name: update_message_template
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Reword a collection reminder or the onboarding invite. kind: friendly, followup, final (email), card_expired, no_card, onboarding_invite. Plain text, texts max 480 chars, keep {pay_link} where the default has it. Merge fields written like {first_name}

tools.name: reset_message_template
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Put one reminder wording back to the Avlira default.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Change an existing commission plan (same fields as create_plan; only what you pass changes). Only FUTURE deals use the new terms; booked deals keep their numbers. remove_cap true = no cap.

tools.name: assign_plan
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Put agents on a plan from a date on (default today): one agent, a list of agents, or 'all'. Earlier deals are unchanged.

tools.name: archive_plan
tools.description: (Needs the workspace_key from create_workspace.) Retire a plan nobody uses any more. Refused (with the agent names) while agents are still on it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: workspace_settings, diagnose, list_message_templates · Private data: create_workspace, florida_license_lookup, record_deal, contact_avlira_support · Public sink: create_workspace, import_roster_csv, diagnose, contact_avlira_support, update_message_template · Destructive: import_roster_csv, reset_branding, reset_message_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: workspace_settings, diagnose, list_message_templates · Private data: create_workspace, florida_license_lookup, record_deal, contact_avlira_support · Public sink: create_workspace, import_roster_csv, diagnose, contact_avlira_support, update_message_template · Destructive: import_roster_csv, reset_branding, reset_message_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
